video_summary.overall_goal: Record blood pressure readings (systolic/diastolic values) and view results on a chart
video_summary.description: User enters systolic and diastolic blood pressure values using the on-screen numeric keyboard, submits the reading, and views the recorded measurement on a chart display.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Blood pressure input form with numeric input fields for systolic and diastolic values. Status bar visible at top. Numeric keyboard not yet visible.
steps.system_response: Input field focused, numeric keyboard appears
steps.intent_task: Begin entering systolic blood pressure value

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Blood pressure input form with systolic field active. Numeric keyboard visible at bottom with blue highlight on keys.
steps.target_element: Systolic input field via numeric keyboard
steps.system_response: Numbers appear in systolic field as user taps keyboard keys
steps.visual_feedback: Numbers entered in field, keyboard keys highlight on tap

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Form with systolic value entered (120). Diastolic field visible below. Numeric keyboard still visible.
Form with systolic=120 entered. Diastolic field now focused. Numeric keyboard visible.
steps.target_element: Diastolic input field via numeric keyboard
steps.visual_feedback: Numbers entered in diastolic field, keyboard keys highlight

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Both systolic (120) and diastolic (80) values entered. Keyboard still visible. User gestures suggest tapping submit or moving to results.
steps.target_element: Submit button or results view trigger
steps.system_response: App processes input and transitions to results/chart view

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Blood pressure measurement result displayed as a chart. Circular gauge visualization showing the recorded reading (120/80). Chart shows blood pressure range and current reading position. Status indicator visible.
steps.system_response: Chart animates and displays the recorded blood pressure reading
steps.navigation_change: Navigated from input screen to results/chart screen
steps.visual_feedback: Chart with gauge visualization, reading clearly displayed, possible animation
steps.intent_task: View recorded blood pressure reading on chart

overall_flow: App displays blood pressure input form
User taps systolic input field, keyboard appears
User enters systolic value (120) via numeric keyboard
User enters diastolic value (80) via numeric keyboard
App displays recorded reading on chart/gauge visualization
human_readable_step_summary: Step 1: App opens on the blood pressure input screen with input fields for systolic and diastolic values.
Step 2: User taps the systolic field and a numeric keyboard appears at the bottom of the screen.
Step 3: User enters the systolic value (120) by tapping the numeric keys on the keyboard.
Step 4: User taps the diastolic input field to move focus there.
Step 5: User enters the diastolic value (80) by tapping the numeric keys.
Step 6: User submits the blood pressure reading by tapping a submit button or equivalent.
Step 7: The app transitions to a results screen showing the recorded blood pressure (120/80) displayed on a circular gauge chart.
